description: This file defines a Console class that wraps around the Rich library's console functionalities, providing methods for printing styled text, filtering tags, blending text colors, and handling user input within the OpenBB CLI application.

classes.name: Console
classes.description: Creates and manages a rich console for the OpenBB CLI, enabling styled output, filtering, and user input.

methods.description: Removes rich tags from a text string based on predefined tags.

methods.description: Creates a Text object with a color gradient blending between two colors.

methods.name: print(self, *args, **kwargs)
methods.description: Outputs text to the console, possibly formatted with panels and version info depending on settings.

methods.name: input(self, *args, **kwargs)
